query:
SELECT MIN(createdAt) as min_created, MAX(createdAt) as max_created,
       MIN(delivered_at) as min_delivered, MAX(delivered_at) as max_delivered
FROM orders
WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL
AND customer_latitude IS NOT NULL
AND customer_longitude IS NOT NULL
